name: Slam Jam
hook: 2-on-2 arcade hoops. Turbo, shove, fly, slam.
how: Run with turbo, shove or steal on defence, and let go of your jump shot at the top of the jump. Near the rim, SHOOT takes off for a flying dunk; score 3 in a row and you catch fire until the other team answers.
controls: WASD or arrows, J shoot, K pass or steal, Shift turbo · touch: stick, SHOOT, PASS, TURBO
uses: The host's browser owns the ball and rolls every shot, steal and block; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill every empty spot, so even alone you play a full 2-on-2.
Each player's most points in one game, shown on the results card.
Every baller, pass, shot and dunk moves for everyone at once.
ideas: Make it a beach court at sunset with a sand floor
Add a 4-point line way out past the 3-point line
Give each team a special move on a meter, like a double-turbo
